mapper.delete: DELETE rr FROM SYS_ROLERES_REF rr JOIN SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES res ON rr.resource_id = res.id WHERE res.module_id = #{mid}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.path, r.code, mr.resource_url FROM sys_module_resources mr, sys_role_module rm, sys_module m, sys_role r WHERE rm.MODULE_ID = m.ID AND rm.ROLE_ID = r.ID AND m.id = mr.module_id AND rm.RESOURCE_ID = mr.ID AND m.isleaf = '1'

SELECT r.ID, r.MODULE_ID, r.RESOURCE_DESC, r.RESOURCE_URL, r.RESOURCE_TYPE, CASE WHEN rr.ROLE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CHECKED FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON r.ID = rr.RESOURCE_ID AND rr.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY r.MODULE_ID ASC;
